# MS Industries

> MS Industries is a Delhi-based manufacturer and supplier of premium catering counters, buffet setups, live counters, food display units, and customized hospitality equipment for hotels, restaurants, banquet halls, and event caterers across Delhi NCR. Established in 2019.

MS Industries specializes in stainless steel fabrication for the hospitality and food service industry. Products include buffet counters, live cooking counters, chaat counters, sweet display counters, food display counters, and fully customized SS counters. Clients include hotels, resorts, restaurants, banquet halls, wedding caterers, food courts, corporate cafeterias, and event management companies, primarily serving Delhi, Noida, Gurgaon, and Faridabad.

## Company

- [Home](https://www.cateringcountermanufacturer.com): Overview of MS Industries, product range, why choose us, industries served, FAQs, and customer reviews.

## Products

- Buffet Counters: Heavy-duty stainless steel buffet counters for hotels and banquet halls.
- Live Cooking Counters: Heat-resistant, mobile counters for live food stations.
- Chaat Counters: Counters with organized storage for toppings and sauces for quick serving.
- Sweet Display Counters: Elegant hygienic display counters for sweets.
- Food Display Counters: Counters for displaying salads, snacks, and prepared dishes.
- Customized SS Counters: Tailor-made stainless steel counters built to custom dimensions.
